sections.title: What are Adverbs?
points: Adverbs modify (describe) VERBS, ADJECTIVES, or other ADVERBS
They usually end in -LY (but not always!)
Adverbs answer: HOW, WHEN, WHERE, WHY, or HOW OFTEN?

sections.title: Types of Adverbs
points: Frequency: HOW OFTEN? (always, never, often, rarely)
Degree: HOW MUCH? (very, quite, too, extremely)

sections.title: Adverb Position
points: Usually placed AFTER the main verb: She sings beautifully
Can go at the BEGINNING: Quickly, she ran away
Frequency adverbs often go BEFORE the main verb: He always arrives late
Can modify entire sentences: Clearly, we should help

sections.text: Tip: Most adverbs = adjective + LY. But watch for: fast→fast, hard→hard, good→well, bad→badly
